description: This file is a main entry point for a Flutter application. It defines the main widget, MyApp, which sets up MaterialApp with theme and home page. It also defines a stateful widget MyHomePage displaying a simple UI with a message and a progress indicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: A stateless widget that sets up the MaterialApp with title, theme, and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays the main content of the app with a title passed via constructor.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class for MyHomePage that builds the UI with an AppBar and centered message with a progress indicator.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main entry point of the application, which runs the app by instantiating MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp and _MyHomePageState.
